title: 3.2.B2 Build-Up — Earth Orbits
description: Add a blue Earth sphere that orbits the sun using Math.cos and Math.sin on frameCount.

steps.title: Create the earth Sphere
steps.instructions: In setup(), add `earth = new Sphere(4, 0, 0, 0.6)` placed at x=4 to start (we'll animate it). Set its color to 'dodgerblue'.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sphere section.

steps.title: Orbit earth around the sun in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), set `earth.position.x = Math.cos(radians(frameCount * 0.6)) * 4` and `earth.position.z = Math.sin(radians(frameCount * 0.6)) * 4`.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the radians() helper section.

requirements.title: earth is a Sphere
requirements.description: A new Sphere is assigned to earth.

requirements.title: earth orbits with cos/sin
requirements.description: earth.position.x is set using Math.cos and radians.
